_comment: Enacted amending Laws of the National Insurance Law [Consolidated Version], 5755-1995, deposited 2026-10-06 for row IL-09 (the repair of IL-04). They are the Knesset's own PDFs of the Reshumot publication, fetched through an ssh SOCKS tunnel to an EC2 instance in il-central-1 because fs.knesset.gov.il is geo-blocked from Singapore. The consolidated Hebrew text in ../ is Wikisource's unofficial consolidation; where it and these Laws disagree, these Laws are the enacted text. First fetched by IL-04's encoder at 14:43 UTC the same day; the sha256 below was re-checked by the lead at 21:38 UTC and matches.

_comment_2026_11_09: Four files added 2026-11-09 by session "israel" for the s 342(e) / Schedule J column question (fork F22 of IL-05): the Law as enacted in 1995, the 1997 Arrangements Law that added s 342(d) and (e), and the two 2002 Laws that replaced Schedule J. Same provenance as above: the Knesset's own PDFs of the Reshumot publication, fetched through the Tel Aviv relay. The text layers of the 1995 PDF are scrambled (visual order); the page images are the evidence.
_comment_2026_11_09_schedule_j: Four files added 2026-11-09 by session "israel" for the correction of seven cells of Schedule J (row IL-04 0.7.0): Sefer HaChukim 2382, 2203, 2429 and 2126. The Knesset's own PDFs of the Reshumot publication. Three were fetched through the Tel Aviv relay (a log line 'HTTP 200' exists for each); for the fourth, Sefer HaChukim 2126, the log line is not retained (see its entry). Sefer HaChukim 2023 (16_lsr_299994.pdf), 3045 (25_lsr_2572039.pdf), 3347 (25_lsr_5482787.pdf) and 3384 (25_lsr_6133485.pdf), which the correction also rests on, were already here. The 'bears_on' field of each says which pages the encoder viewed as images and which not.
